title: Don_t_Axis
slide_intent: Reject diagonal travel when a system relies on clear axes because mixed paths weaken orientation.
strategic_value: The marked counterexample can keep DB’s direction of movement consistent across layouts.
demonstration: The photograph enters diagonally beside the same dark message panel, and a cyan diagonal line marks the example as rejected.
practical_value: Compare the image trajectory with DBV45 and keep new animations on the defined straight axes.

content_islands.name: Diagonal entrance
content_islands.spec: Observe the photograph approaching its right-hand position off the horizontal axis.

content_islands.name: Rejection mark
content_islands.spec: Retain the cyan strike that identifies the movement as disallowed.

reference_purposes.Expression: The photograph enters diagonally beside the same dark message panel, and a cyan diagonal line marks the example as rejected.
